import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customer } from "./customer";

export const employee = defineTable("employee", {
    columns: {
        employeeId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        lastName: col.varchar(20).notNull(),
        firstName: col.varchar(20).notNull(),
        title: col.varchar(30),
        reportsTo: col.integer(),
        birthDate: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        hireDate: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        address: col.varchar(70),
        city: col.varchar(40),
        state: col.varchar(40),
        country: col.varchar(40),
        postalCode: col.varchar(10),
        phone: col.varchar(24),
        fax: col.varchar(24),
        email: col.varchar(60)
    },
    relations: {
        reportsToRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => employee, { localKey: "reports_to", onDelete: "no action" }),
        customer: rel.hasMany(() => customer, { foreignKey: "support_rep_id" }),
        employee: rel.hasMany(() => employee, { foreignKey: "reports_to" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
